title: Google said on 20 Nov 2026 that it will retire Google Assistant on its speakers and smart displays (Google Home, Nest Mini, Nest Audio, Nest Hub etc.) on 2 August 2027, replacing it with Gemini for Home; the separate Nest app closes on 25 January 2027 and Nest devices move to the Google Home app. Google's Help Centre lists early access to Gemini for Home in India as 'coming in December' (2026). Basic Gemini for Home features (smart home controls, media, alarms, timers, lists, reminders) are free; Gemini Live needs a paid Google Home Premium plan. A home that switches to Gemini cannot switch back. The early-access language list includes English but no Hindi or other Indian language; Google says other languages follow 'over time'. Full Gemini on Nest Mini (2nd gen), Nest Audio, Nest Hub (1st/2nd gen), Nest Hub Max, Home Mini (1st gen), Google Home Speaker (2026); original Google Home, Home Max and Nest Wifi point get most features but not Gemini Live.
headline: Gemini Takes Over Nest Speakers; India Early Access in December

fact_sources.fact: Google Assistant on Google's speakers and smart displays retires on 2 August 2027; Gemini for Home voice assistant fully replaces it (announced 20 Nov 2026)
The Nest app (Android, iOS, web) closes on 25 January 2027; Nest devices move to the Google Home app
Gemini for Home early access for India is listed as 'coming in December' (no specific date)
Basic Gemini for Home features (smart home controls, media search and playback, alarms and timers, calendars, notes, lists, reminders) are free; Gemini Live needs a Google Home Premium subscription
Once a home switches to Gemini for Home it can't switch back to Google Assistant
Early-access language list includes English but no Hindi or other Indian language; other languages and countries get access 'over time'

Full Gemini for Home on Nest Mini (2nd gen), Nest Audio, Nest Hub (1st and 2nd gen), Nest Hub Max, Home Mini (1st gen), Google Home Speaker (2026); original Google Home, Google Home Max and Nest Wifi point get most features but not Gemini Live

Gemini for Home's early-access language list has 13 entries (Chinese Traditional*, Danish, Dutch, English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean*, Norwegian, Portuguese*, Spanish, Swedish; * = coming in December), none of them Hindi or another Indian language (count taken from Google's official list)

Existing Google/Nest speakers and displays get Gemini for Home; no new device needed (Google: 'Every device supported today works with these updated experiences'; upgrading is free and 'available across all devices'; compatible-device list covers Nest Mini, Nest Audio, Nest Hub, Home Mini, original Google Home etc.)
